description: This file defines the SkillDao class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for performing data access operations related to the 'Skill' entity, including CRUD operations, search, and pagination.

classes.name: SkillDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for skills, providing methods to save, retrieve, delete, and search Skill entities in the database.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Persists a Skill entity in the database and returns it.

methods.name: getSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingSkillIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing skill IDs from a provided list.

methods.name: deleteSkills
methods.description: Deletes skills based on provided IDs and returns the number of deleted records.

methods.name: searchSkill
methods.description: Performs a search for skills based on filter parameters, returning matching entities.

methods.name: getSearchSkillPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object to facilitate paginated search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of skills matching specified filter parameters.
